# WGOM Atlantic Cod and GOM Haddock Catch at Length 

**Description**: 

This data contains the proportions of fish caught at length in inches by season for
Western Gulf of Maine (WGOM) Atlantic Cod and Gulf of Maine (GOM) Haddock.
The 'summer' season is May - August and the 'winter' is September - April. 
We provide the medians of 101 random draws of the observed proportions caught at length 
and the fitted (i.e., smoothed) proportions. 

**Years available**: 

The data are for the baseline regulatory year, also called the calibration year. 
Baseline simulated catch at length is based on the most recent 6 waves of data. 
For the 2026 management cycle, catch at length was simulated using data for 
waves 1-5 of 2025 and wave 6 of 2024.

## Methods

### Data sources

We get data on catch, effort, and numbers of fish caught at length from the Marine 
Recreational Information Program ([MRIP](https://www.fisheries.noaa.gov/insight/marine-recreational-information-program)). 

### Data extraction 

MRIP provides a sample of fish harvested at length and a sample of fish 
discarded at length, the latter of which comes from headboat observations. 

The data is limited to the WGOM, which includes any Maine or Massachusetts trips taken in 
statistical areas 513, 514, 515, 521, and 526, as well as any trips taken from New Hampshire. 
GOM Haddock are assessed in statistical areas 513, 514, 515, 511, and 512, but no Haddock 
are caught in areas 511 and 512 while very few Haddock are caught in areas 521 and 526. 

![Northeast Atlantic Cod Statistical Areas with Stock Areas](stat_areas.jpg)

### Data analysis/Processing

[Data processing code](https://github.com/kimberly-bastille/groundfishRDM/blob/main/Code/pre_sim) 
is in the groundfishRDM repository. 

We use the samples of the number of fish discarded at length and harvested at length 
to get probability distributions for both by season for each species. Next, we multiply 
the harvest at length probability distribution by 101 draws of simulated total harvest 
and we multiply the discards at length probability distribution by 101 draws of simulated 
total discards. The simulated total numbers of fish harvested and discarded are based on 
random draws of simulated directed trips and simulated harvest- and discards per trip. 

We add the simulated total harvest and discards at length to get 101 draws of total 
numbers of fish caught at length, and then convert the numbers to proportions which form the 
'observed' catch at length distribution draws. We then fit these observed probabilities 
to a gamma distribution to get a smoothed distribution. These fitted probabilities are fed into 
the model. Finally, we take the medians of the 101 draws of observed and fitted catch at 
length probabilities by season for cod and haddock.  

The metric column in the raw data has the season and the length of the fish in inches. 
We receive the fish lengths in centimeters and convert them to inches, which is why
the lengths are non-integers in the raw data.
